decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is occupied.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no windows other than those expressly authorised by this permission shall be constructed.

Condition : 5 - Details of the new windows to the flank extension and replacement to the porch at scale 1:20 be submitted and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the commencement of works.
Condition : 6 - Details of the front fascia be submitted and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the commencement of works.
description: Erection of two storey side extension to existing dwellinghouse.
